messages:
Alex (Sales): Hey team — Hyperlytics wants a live demo Wed 2025-06-04 16:00 UTC. They need a brief dedicated capacity bump for embeddings + chat for ~4h. Can we do a temporary autoscale/burst increase for their POC pool? Details: model: star-embed-xxl, peak qps ~200, avg seq len ~1024. Need API keys + KMS access. Any blockers? :eyes:

Sarah (Solutions Eng): Quick q — which pool/region? Do they already have a Dedicated pool id? Also will they need Private/VPC peering or is hosted keys fine for the demo?

Alex (Sales): Pool id: ded-poc-hyper-03 (us-west-2). They currently have hosted keys for dev but security wants customer-managed KMS + audit logs for the demo.

Maria (SRE): We can top up by up to 6 GPUs for a 4h window as a temporary burst but this needs capacity-ops + finance sign-off for overage. What's the tokens/hr estimate and latency SLO?

Alex (Sales): Estimate ~120M tokens/hr peak. 99p latency target <300ms. Customer fine with pay-as-you-go overage at list rate. Also, can we configure automatic fallback to a smaller model if we hit capacity limits?

Jon (Infra Eng): Yes — fallback is doable. Recommend an autoscale policy with a hard cap and model fallback. Canary rollout 15m, max_concurrency 8 per GPU, cooldown 10m. Sample config below.

Jon (Infra Eng): ```
autoscale_policy {
  pool_id: "ded-poc-hyper-03"
  bump_gpus: 6
  window: "4h"
  canary: "15m"
  fallback_model: "star-embed-large"
  max_concurrency_per_gpu: 8
  cooldown: "10m"
}
```

Maria (SRE): Also require ephemeral API keys scoped to embedding+generate endpoints, an auditor ACL, and KMS key attachment. OpsBot — please open a capacity request ticket and include finance estimate.

OpsBot: Created ticket CI-2025-443: TEMP_BURST_HYPERLYTICS. Assigned to @Jon (Infra Eng). SLA: 24h.

Sarah (Solutions Eng): FYI — this will change billing visibility. I'll send the customer a per-token estimate and call out the burst premium. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/pricing#burst

Alex (Sales): Can we fast-track KMS onboarding? They already signed an MSA; security gave a preliminary OK on minimal controls.

Maria (SRE): KMS onboarding for a new customer-managed key typically takes ~2 business days to validate ARNs and attach IAM roles. If they can provide the key ARN and an IAM role with trusting policy, that speeds things up. Need contact.

Alex (Sales): Contact: security@hyperlytics.com — I'll send the onboarding checklist and ask for the ARN + role.

Jon (Infra Eng): I'll provision canary nodes tomorrow 09:00 UTC and wire the autoscale policy. If canary fails, traffic will auto-fallback to hosted endpoint with reduced concurrency. :thumbsup:

Alex (Sales): Please post progress here. We also need final finance approval once Ops posts the cost delta.

OpsBot: Finance approval required — notified @Finance. Ticket CI-2025-443 updated with request.

Finance (Finance): Noted. We will review and sign off after Ops posts the estimated overage. Ping us once the estimate is in the ticket.

Maria (SRE): Preliminary estimate: ~$3,600 for the 4h bump (6x A100-equivalent) + burst premium, assuming 120M tokens/hr peak. Actual will vary with token usage and tail latency.

Alex (Sales): Forwarding estimate to Hyperlytics. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

Sarah (Solutions Eng): One more — we'll enforce a post-demo teardown policy: automatic drain at window end and revoke ephemeral keys. Please ensure the teardown is documented in the ticket.

Jon (Infra Eng): Confirmed — teardown at window end + 30m safe drain and key revocation.

Alex (Sales): Closing loop for now: Demo scheduled, CI-2025-443 open, KMS PO emailed to customer. I will update thread after customer confirms the ARN and signs the overage.
